label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, hey there, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
What
brings
you
back
up here?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_select_01
text: I just wanted to chat!

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_select_02
text: I could ask you the same

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_02
text: To chat? With me? Well, well—aren’t I the\npopular one![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_03
text: Me? Oh, I’m just enjoying the ocean breeze,\nstaring at the battle court, hoping for an\r\ninteresting match to start up or something.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_04
text: By the by, how’s that Blueberry Pokédex of yours\ncoming along?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_05
text: Come show me once you’ve filled it in a bit![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_first_06
text: And definitely come show me if you complete it!\nI’ll be sure to shower you with praise![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_02
text: It looks like you’ve caught...[VAR 0x0202(0001)] species of\nPokémon in the Terarium![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_03
text: Just getting started, huh?\c\nWell, don’t get discouraged! You only just arrived\nhere, after all.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_04
text: You’re starting to make some headway, I see.\c\nDon’t be afraid to explore all the Terarium’s\nbiomes! Each one is unique from the others![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_05
text:
That’s a pretty good collection you’ve got going!\c
Lots of different Pokémon in the Terarium, right?
It takes serious cash to keep the temperatures
regulated throughout that whole thing![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_06
text: Wow, you’ve really got a knack for this!\c\nSince you’ve come this far already, you might as\nwell go all the way and complete the ’Dex![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_07
text: Hold on—does that mean you’ve filled in the\nentire thing?![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_08
text: Yes! Yes, it does! You’ve completed the Blueberry\nPokédex! Congratulations![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_09
text: We should have all the data we need on the\nPokémon living in the dome now, thanks to you![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_10
text: This is really impressive, you know. Not a single\nBlueberry Academy student has managed it yet![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_11
text: Here, you deserve a special something to\ncelebrate. I’m pretty sure this counts as special...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_01
text: Why, hello, Director Cyrano. And hello to you\ntoo, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nYour studies are going well, I hope?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_12
text: Welcome, Velly! You’re not going to believe what\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] just accomplished![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_02
text: Upon my word![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_03
text: It seems you’re making quite the splash here at\nBlueberry Academy, as you have elsewhere.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_13
text: Heh heh heh... I knew I’d picked the right student\nfor this program.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_04
text: While Director Cyrano is giving himself a hearty\npat on the back, allow me to reward you with a\r\nsmall gift.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_05
text:
Students who achieve great feats such as this
deserve to be recognized for their hard work.\c
This congratulatory message, penned by the
company that certifies Pokédex completion,
is for you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_06
text: I reconfigured your Pokédex app so that you may\nview your diploma there anytime you like.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_14
text: You haven’t changed, have you, Velly? You’ve\nalways been good at this sort of thing.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_07
text: Oh no, this really is nothing...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_08
text: Also, Director, once again I must insist that you\naddress me properly in front of our studen—[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_15
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’m just glad your Treasure Hunt at my academy\nhas been such a success,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_33
text: I hope you keep spending some quality time with\nall the Pokémon in the Terarium![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_09
text: Er, Director Cyrano? I do appreciate your kind\nwords, and I hate to interrupt...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_10
text: But I would like you to confirm that you will no\nlonger refer to me as “Velly” in front...of...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_head_11
text: ...Director Cyrano? Are you even listening to me?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_18
text:
Good morning there! You’re certainly an early
riser!\c
Me, I just don’t sleep all that long anymore. It’s
something that happens as you get older.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_19
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello there, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I hope
you’re
enjoying
your
time
at
Blueberry
Academy.\c
You’re free to do as you please, really—catch
lots of Pokémon, do a bunch of BBQs...whatever![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_20
text:
This really is the best place to enjoy a view of the
sunset, don’t you think?\c
Why, it was worth building a school smack in the
middle of the ocean just for this view![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_21
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Good evening, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
You’re
full
of
energy
even
at
this
hour, eh?\c
I think I’ll call it a day soon, though. Old guys like
me need to go to bed early![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_22
text:
Wonderful morning, isn’t it? If you like the rain,
that is!\c
Of course, here at Blueberry Academy, it doesn’t
matter if you get wet—people will just think you
got a splash of ocean spray![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_23
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Howdy, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! The rain just
keeps
coming
down,
doesn’t
it?\c
We could have put a roof over the entrance area,
but I decided against it. So many Pokémon like
the rain, after all![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_24
text:
We won’t be getting a view of the sunset tonight.
That’s too bad!\c
I guess I’ll just go enjoy the artificial sunset in the
Terarium![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_25
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Good evening there, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
I
see
it
takes
more
than
just
rain
to
stop
you!\c
Just be careful—the floors can get slippery. Don’t
lose your footing and slip into the ocean![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: s2_sub_010_headbb_stop
text: If you’ve completed the Blueberry Pokédex,\npress the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]X Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] in the Pokédex app to\r\nmark it as done, and then come show me![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
